body:
Twin of ratel `refactor/move-apps-web-to-src`: ratel moves its app from `apps/web` to `src` (plan "Ratel consolidation", RP-34).

## Contains (merge after them)

This branch starts at `plan/phase-0` (#117) and merges #116 and #115 with `git merge --no-ff`. **Merge this PR after #116, #115 and #117, and after the ratel twin.**

## Change

The path commit:
- `.github/workflows/build.yml` and `ci.yml` build `src/Dockerfile`.
- `db/` (cutover, bundle-migrator and the migration tests) and the identity test read the core migrations from `src/lib/platform/db`.
- The RP-84 parity script takes the app folder per checkout: `apps/web` for ratel-cloud, `src` for ratel.
- Docs and comments that name ratel paths: README, CONTRIBUTING, `.env.example`, `proxy.ts`, deploy values and scripts.

These stay `apps/web` because they name ratel-cloud paths: `platform-sync/`, `db/cutover.integration.test.ts`, the generated `health/cli` header and the `infra/` comments. `infra/README.md` and `infra/module/dashboards_*.tf` also hold three comments that name ratel paths. Those files belong to RP-66 (#115), so I left them.

Also `style(access): format feature-flags test`: `plan/phase-0` left one line past biome's width, so the ee lint step failed.

CI pairs this PR with the ratel branch of the same name.

## CI on the pair

- ratel (workflow_dispatch, because draft PRs skip CI): [run 44958945146](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/actions/runs/44958945146) is green on e396256e. That covers the OSS Docker build (`platform-build`), `platform-compose`, the four test shards, `deploy`, `secret-scan` and `dependency-scan`.
- ratel-platform #118: [run 44955882363](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/actions/runs/44955882363) is green. That covers the Cloud Docker build (`cloud`) and the four test shards against this branch.

## Checks run locally

- Cloud typecheck with ratel `refactor/move-apps-web-to-src`: passes. `check:boundary`: clean.
- `db/migrate`, `db/schema`, `db/core` and `identity/queries` tests: 18 pass.

## Proof

Final pair: ratel `9ceeae3f`, ratel-platform `c0d67c56` (both `refactor/move-apps-web-to-src`).

- CI on the pair is green. ratel: [run 44960332927](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel/actions/runs/44960332927) (OSS Docker build, compose, tests, deploy, scans). ratel-platform: [run 44960334906](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/actions/runs/44960334906) (Cloud Docker build, tests).
- Local Cloud boot: `next build` with `RATEL_COMPOSITION=cloud`, then the standalone `src/server.js` as the image runs it, `DEV_AUTH_BYPASS=1`, and a fresh Postgres migrated by `ee/src/db/bundle-migrator.mjs`. `GET /api/health` answers `{"status":"ok","edition":"Ratel Cloud"}`. `/` goes to `/organizations`, and the Cloud launch gate shows the waitlist.

![Local Cloud boot on src](https://github.com/ratel-ai/ratel-platform/blob/proof/rp-34/01-cloud-boot.png?raw=true)
